title: [MSL] Force-close open positions at backtest end
description: engine.py:356-399 — Final equity includes unrealized PnL but trade stats exclude any still-open position at last bar. Force-close at last bar price so trades/win_rate/profit_factor/total_trades are all consistent. P0 — distorts all backtest comparisons.

title: [MSL] Fix double cooldown decrement on pending-signal bars
description: engine.py:221-225 and 333-335 — When pending_signal exists and cooldown_remaining > 0, cooldown decrements in the pending block then again in the generic tick block. Add a guard flag so it only decrements once per bar. P0 — inflates trade frequency and distorts performance.

title: [MSL] Remove atr_filter_mult from optimizer / wire it up in strategy
description: optimizer.py:33-38 + sma_crossover.py:24,64-77 — Parameter is in the grid but never applied in strategy logic. Either wire it up as an actual ATR volatility filter gate or remove it from the optimizer grid entirely. P0 — wastes search budget and produces misleading best params.

title: [MSL] Fix inverted RSI mean-reversion strength formula
description: rsi_mean_reversion.py:90-95 — Strength should be highest near the oversold/overbought threshold (strongest reversal context), not far from it. Invert the formula: strength = 1 - abs(rsi_oversold - rsi)/rsi_oversold (normalized). Fix both BUY and SELL sides. P1.

title: [MSL] Fix higher-TF bias to use active strategy set only
description: signals/engine.py:100-112 — _get_higher_tf_bias loops STRATEGY_REGISTRY instead of strategies_config keys. Restrict to active strategies so bias doesn't silently include out-of-run strategies. P1 — breaks reproducibility.

title: [MSL] Add proper error handling to ML filter inference loop
description: engine.py:573-584 — Bare except: pass swallows per-bar inference errors silently. Replace with logged exception + fallback behavior (pass-through or conservative filter). Add audit trail for ML-gated bars. P1 — trust/debuggability.

title: [MSL] Fix CAGR calculation for sub-24h backtests
description: metrics.py:49-55 — Uses timedelta.days which returns 0 for intraday spans under 24h, forcing CAGR to 0. Switch to total_seconds()/86400 for fractional day support. P1 — breaks short-horizon evaluation.

title: [MSL] Add engine integration tests (8 missing coverage areas)
description: tests/test_backtest.py + test_strategies.py — Add tests for: (1) end-of-data position force-close, (2) cooldown semantics, (3) fee/slippage execution path, (4) short-side lifecycle, (5) ML filter integration failure modes, (6) optimizer no-op param detection, (7) concrete strategy classes (not just simulations), (8) reproducibility of higher-TF bias with active strategy set only. P1.

This card is a growth experiment: run a 30-day acquisition pilot for one of your apps (CoinUsUp or Even Us Up) across 1-2 new channels, track CAC vs LTV, run creative tests, and reallocate budget weekly.

comments.author: alfred
comments.text:
CAC = Customer Acquisition Cost (how much you spend to get one paying user). LTV = Lifetime Value (total revenue one customer generates over their lifetime). You want LTV > CAC to be profitable.

Honestly, this card is probably premature. Before a paid acquisition pilot makes sense, you need: (1) a clear conversion funnel, (2) baseline data on free-to-paid conversion rate, (3) a budget comfortable to burn on experiments.

Recommendation: park this card back in Ideas until one of your apps is stable and ready to grow. Pulling it back later when the context is right will be much more productive than forcing it now.

title: Backpressure Pattern — Multi-Agent Coordination Docs
description: From Moltbook m/general [190↑]: Cascading retries across agent chains (A→B→C) create 27x failure amplification. Three patterns to document: (1) Reserve capacity quotas — each agent declares max concurrent jobs, refuses excess with backpressure signal instead of queuing indefinitely; (2) Degradation chains — if downstream agent is slow, upstream switches to cheaper/faster model or skips non-critical steps; (3) Deadline propagation — pass original deadline through all agent hops, so C doesn't start a 10-min task when only 2 min remain. Action: Document all three patterns in AGENTS-EXTENDED.md under a new 'Multi-Agent Coordination' section. Cost: $0 — documentation only. Relevant to any future multi-agent pipelines Joe builds.
